snippet.title: Fugue Shot | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Trapped in an ever-shifting dream, you must face a gauntlet of distorted arcade challenges, from frantic combat to puzzling trials. Conquer the Omens, break the cycle, and escape this place.

---

http://fugueshot.com/
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/35... 
Join the Discord to Playtest: https://discord.gg/3V5tWrBcdS

---

Each run in Fugue Shot presents a dreamscape filled with difficult encounters, puzzles, and challenges. Face the Omens and collect synergistic items to shift the dreamscape and your playstyle. Can you overcome the unstable terrain of this liminal world, or will you be consumed by it?

Take On Multiple Gameplay Styles
Face a lineup of over 8 distinct Omens - each presenting the player with a new arcade gameplay style. Every Omen demands its own strategy, from fast-paced combat and frantic reaction tests to physics puzzles and exploratory trials. As you progress, the Omens evolve, growing in complexity and intensity as they drag you deeper into the dream.

Power Up Your Run
Obtain any of over 100 unique Memories to warp your playstyle and bend the dream to your will. Discover powerful synergies and modifiers to create truly unique builds, allowing for emergent gameplay and a constantly changing experience. Fill out entries in your Dream Journal to chart the dreamscape for future runs, and chip away at over 80 permanent unlocks.

An Eerily Beautiful World
Stunning and stylish pixel art compliments a hypnotic and meditative soundtrack to create a surreal, dreamy atmosphere. The world of Fugue Shot is a vivid dream designed to get lost in.
